rule: a sibling subfamily is a set of channels measuring the SAME physical quantity on a channel/chord series
test: same dimensional signature AND same scientific-description stem AND an indexed channel series
s7_3_refinement: the CER provider group splits into two sibling subfamilies. CER toroidal rotation is a velocity and CER ion temperature is a temperature: different physical quantities, different dimensions, different descriptions. Siblings within each series, not across them. This follows the frozen purpose of the sibling rule -- preventing trivial same-quantity channel interpolation -- rather than the provider grouping label.

not_sibling_families.magnetics: bt, ip, pcbcoil, pcdiamag3, vsurf are five distinct quantities, not a channel series
not_sibling_families.density_group: line-averaged density, pedestal density and pedestal temperature are distinct quantities
not_sibling_families.gas_injection: four separate manifolds; treated as actuation, and not a same-quantity channel series of a measured plasma quantity
